principles: Use only authorized accounts, data, providers and actions.
Preserve failed and uncertain outcomes with source identity.
Keep independent verification separate from production and hashes.
Never represent an internal deadline or rubric as official competition rules.
Publish only sanitized public materials; private workspace data stays private.
Every advertised capability needs rendered/native and deployed evidence or an explicit limitation.

milestones.title: Foundations
required: Required CI jobs execute
Locked dependencies resolve
Build and release identities agree
No skipped required gate is counted as passing

milestones.title: Authentication and onboarding
required: Fresh account completes atomic onboarding
Retry and concurrent setup create one workspace
Sign out and sign in restore the same workspace
Password reset and account switching are observed

milestones.title: Workspace isolation and persistence
required: Both declared backend versions execute native tests
Current membership protects every read and write
Restart preserves receipts and records
Retention-aware migration rollback is rehearsed

milestones.title: Signals
required: Permitted source is actually captured
Source URL, text digest and time are retained
Duplicate captures do not create duplicate signals
Exactly one recoverable mission proposal follows the signal

milestones.title: Bounded business actions
required: Frozen inputs and approved mission precede effects
An actual business action returns a receipt
Scope revocation stops undispatched work
Timeouts retain uncertainty and cannot cause blind retries

milestones.title: Workflows
required: Approval checkpoint guards executable steps
Step events and evidence are atomic
Cancellation and late results retain the actual outcome
Replay is a read and never reruns effects

milestones.title: Connectors
required: Firecrawl and n8n use registered workspace bindings
Health observations match current configuration revision
Disabled, stale and unavailable providers fail closed
n8n reconciliation reads an existing effect receipt

milestones.title: ERP
required: Create, link, edit and reload tasks, objectives and contacts
Executed tasks retain mission, execution and evidence references
Foreign relationships are rejected by the backend
Task completion is distinct from objective verification

milestones.title: Evidence
required: Reviewed evidence versions remain exact
Execution receipts cannot be rewritten through ordinary requests
Producer and verifier are distinct
Candidate, artifact and provider receipts reconcile

milestones.title: Edition, desks and assistant
required: Failed reads remain visible
Verification dates use actual review stamps
Specialist desks connect to their working tools
Assistant conversations and patterns are account/workspace isolated
Assistant actions use native permissions and human decisions remain explicit

milestones.title: Replay and submission
required: One actual deployed input-to-independent-review journey is retained
All eleven owner-reviewed milestones have current evidence
Public submission materials match the accepted candidate
Official requirements are confirmed separately before entry

submission_gate: All eleven milestones, current required profiles, real replay, owner review and confirmed official requirements are required. Preparation is allowed while the gate remains HOLD.
